electric.method: PECO average price 18.02 cents/kWh (EIA-861 2025, revenue / sales, residential, bundled service (Part A)) x 219 kWh/month (2631 kWh/year): RECS 2020 microdata, Northeast (Middle Atlantic + New England) apartments in 5+ unit buildings whose main heat is not electric, studio, weighted mean, n=18; small sample. Cross-check: published Table CE2.2 gives 4,650 kWh/year for all such apartments, electric heat included. Territory: point-in-polygon on HIFLD/ORNL Electric Retail Service Territories (2022 vintage), with documented overrides.

if_heat_is_electric_add.note: RECS 2020 space-heating kWh in electrically heated Northeast apartments (5+ units), n=18; applies only if the tenant pays for electric heat. Not added to the amount.

gas.reason: no residential minimum monthly charge held for Peco Energy Co: no official tariff or rate page was collected for this utility. A cooking-only bill is almost all fixed charge, so no figure is given rather than a misleading $2-3.

heating_component_if_tenant_pays.note: PA average residential gas price $1.452/therm (EIA 2025 annual, $15.04/Mcf at 1036 Btu per cubic foot) x RECS space-heating therms; excludes the fixed monthly charge. Not a total.
